name: Sparkpost
description: Integrates Drupal site with Sparkpost - transactional mail service.

suggests.drupal/mailsystem: Optional. Use Mailsystem to select the Sparkpost mail plugin per module/key or as the site default; without it, set system.mail interface.default to sparkpost_mail.

provides_plugin_types: Mail plugin (@Mail id: sparkpost_mail) — implements Drupal\Core\Mail\MailInterface
QueueWorker plugin (@QueueWorker id: sparkpost_send) — processes async/requeued sends
project_description: Integrates a Drupal site with SparkPost, a transactional email delivery service. The module ships a core Mail plugin (sparkpost_mail) that turns each outgoing Drupal message into a SparkPost transmissions API call via the sparkpost/sparkpost v2 PHP SDK (over Drupal's http_client and the php-http/guzzle7-adapter). A settings form at /admin/config/services/sparkpost holds the API key, host (US or EU), from address/name, optional body input format, and an async/queue toggle; a test-mail form (with optional attachment) verifies the setup. Sending can run synchronously or be queued to the sparkpost_send queue and processed on cron or via Drush. The sparkpost_requeue submodule re-queues failed sends with a configurable retry cap and minimum delay. Requires the sparkpost/sparkpost ^2.0 and php-http/guzzle7-adapter ^1.0 Composer packages. This 3.0.x line is an alpha (3.0.0-alpha2).
